boundaries.name: LatticeHardness
boundaries.obligation: NTRU/GPV unforgeability: nothing in the model implies that a witness passing the norm bound was produced by the key holder.

boundaries.name: PoseidonCallback
boundaries.obligation: Poseidon collision and preimage resistance under IMFK; identity-binding theorems carry injectivity on the compared pair as an explicit premise.

boundaries.name: HashToPointCallback
boundaries.obligation: hash_to_point_poseidon is an opaque function of (salt elements, message digest); its sponge layout, uniformity and 2^-50 bias bound are not modelled.

boundaries.name: PolynomialProductNTT
boundaries.obligation: The vendored FastFft product equals the negacyclic product in Z_q[X]/(X^512+1) that the model abstracts as PolynomialProduct.mul.

boundaries.name: KeygenAndSampler
boundaries.obligation: Key generation, the ChaCha20 seed derivation, salt freshness and the ffSampling trapdoor sampler are outside the model.

boundaries.name: NativeRustRefinement
boundaries.obligation: The Rust code compiles to the modelled semantics (integer widths, panic=abort behaviour, slice indexing).
